displayName: SIG — Cloud Run job execution failed

documentation.content: A scheduled SIG Cloud Run job execution failed — including sig-probe. Check: gcloud run jobs executions list --region us-central1 --job <job_name>. sig-probe was excluded while it failed every sweep on a stale image (Track 0.5); the exclusion was lifted 2026-10-02 by P34.4 after its re-roll onto the current cadence went green. Re-notifies at most daily while an incident stays open (notificationRateLimit 86400s).
